deviation: Confidentiality survives only 1 year after the Agreement ends, below the 3-year standard and the 2-year fallback, and there is no indefinite protection for trade secrets. Arcadia's confidential information and trade secrets could be freely used or disclosed after year one.
suggested_text: 7.4 The obligations in this Section 7 survive for 3 years after this Agreement ends, provided that obligations in respect of any Confidential Information that constitutes a trade secret shall continue for as long as that information remains a trade secret.
